hero.description: Real-time monitoring of Vannamei shrimp growth using Computer Vision and precision IoT control.

features.sectionDescription: Four technology pillars working synergistically to increase farm efficiency and productivity.

aiGrowth.title: AI Growth Monitoring
aiGrowth.description: Automatic detection of shrimp length and weight using YOLOv11 model and high-precision regression.

iotControl.title: IoT Smart Control
iotControl.description: Electric power monitoring (PZEM-004T) and automatic paddlewheel control using ESP32.

edgeComputing.title: Edge Computing
edgeComputing.description: Seamless integration with Jetson Nano hardware for on-site video processing at the farm.

analytics.title: Real-time Analytics
analytics.description: Interactive data visualization to monitor farm ecosystem health in real-time.

howItWorks.sectionTitle: From Camera to Dashboard in Seconds

step1.title: Capture & Analyze
step1.description: Camera captures shrimp images, then AI automatically identifies size and weight.

step2.title: Edge Processing
step2.description: Data is processed directly on the Jetson Nano, reducing latency and internet dependency.

step3.title: Visualize & Act
step3.description: Analysis results displayed on a real-time dashboard and IoT devices respond automatically.

techStack.sectionDescription: A combination of advanced frameworks and hardware for optimal performance.

webgis.description: Visualize all your farm locations in one interactive map. Monitor the status of each pond, connected devices, and environmental conditions spatially.
webgis.feature1: Real-time farm locations with GPS coordinates
webgis.feature2: Water quality data overlay per pond
webgis.feature3: Spatial analysis of surrounding farm areas

cta.title: Ready to Optimize Your Farm?
cta.description: Start smart monitoring now and increase your shrimp farm productivity.

about.description: We are a team of students and researchers passionate about combining artificial intelligence with aquaculture to help Indonesian farmers increase yields sustainably.

footer.tagline: Smart solution for Vannamei shrimp farm management using AI Computer Vision and IoT.
